comments: Cancel your plans. All of them.
Even your coffee will betray you today.
The universe called in sick to avoid dealing with your day.
Today is not your day. Tomorrow isn't looking great either.
Reply-all that email? Today's the day it happens.
Your phone will autocorrect something unforgivable.
Somewhere, a printer is jamming specifically for you.
You will step on something wet and never find out what it was.
Today's forecast: mild chaos with a chance of regret.
Your WiFi will disconnect at the worst possible moment.
You are the reason this meeting could have been an email.
Something small will break today. Probably your patience.
Your charger will only work at one exact angle today.
Every line you pick will be the slowest one. Every single time.
You will wave back at someone who was waving behind you.
Your sock will slide down inside your shoe. Repeatedly. All day.
The elevator will stop at every floor today. You're on the fifth.
You will find a raisin in the cookie. There were supposed to be no raisins.
Your umbrella will flip inside out in front of everyone you know.
A bird has marked your freshly washed car. It trained for this.
Your headphones will die right before the chorus. Of course they will.
The printer will jam. Then unjam. Then jam again out of spite.
You will reply 'no problem!' to an email that absolutely was a problem.
Your ice cream will fall off the cone. The ground will catch it.
Not a disaster, just... disappointing.
You'll misplace something small and important. Good luck.
Today rewards low expectations. Keep them low.
A minor inconvenience is coming. Brace accordingly.
You'll say 'you too' when someone tells you to enjoy your meal.
Your snack will finish faster than expected. Grieve accordingly.
Someone will 'reply all' before you today. It won't be you this time.
You'll open three apps and forget why.
Today has main character energy, but you're a background extra.
Your socks will not match. Nobody will tell you.
A small awkward silence is scheduled for 2:47 PM.
Your food will arrive slightly colder than it should be. Acceptable. Sad.
You'll send a message to the wrong chat. It could have been worse.
The vending machine will eat your coin and give you nothing. Again.
You'll remember an embarrassing memory mid-shower today. Classic brain.
Your favorite pen will run out mid-signature.
Someone will take the last piece of cake before you get there.
Your phone battery will hit 5% exactly when you need it most.
You'll walk into a room and forget why. It'll come back. Eventually.
The bus will arrive just as you're locking the door. Too slow.
You'll get a haircut that's technically fine but not what you asked for.
Your umbrella is at home. It will rain. Briefly. Just enough.
Today is aggressively fine. Nothing to report.
You will survive today. That's the whole prophecy.
Beige energy. Not bad, not exciting, just... there.
A perfectly forgettable day awaits you.
You'll eat something decent. That's your win for today.
Nothing dramatic happens. Enjoy the peace while it lasts.
Today is the human equivalent of elevator music.
You'll get through your to-do list. Slowly. But you'll get there.
A quiet, unremarkable Tuesday energy, even if it's not Tuesday.
Nobody will text you back immediately, but nobody's mad either.
Today asks for nothing extraordinary from you. Take the win.
You'll wait for something. It'll take about as long as expected.
Today runs on standard settings. No updates installed overnight.
Your coffee will be warm. Not great. Not cold. Warm.
A stranger will nod at you. You'll nod back. That's the whole story.
You'll do a medium amount of things today. Solidly average output.
The weather will do whatever the weather does. Bring a light jacket.
Your package status will change to 'out for delivery.' It stays there.
You'll have a thought worth sharing. You'll decide against it. Fair.
Dinner will exist. It will contain calories. Mission accomplished.
Nothing will go wrong if you don't count the small stuff. Don't count it.
The day will end at the usual time. Wild concept, reliable schedule.
Someone will laugh at your joke today, genuinely.
You'll find money in an old pocket. Small, but sacred.
Traffic, lines, and WiFi will all cooperate. Suspicious, but take it.
You'll get a text that makes you smile for no reason.
Today rewards showing up. So show up.
Your playlist will hit different today. In a good way.
Someone will remember something nice you did. It'll come back around.
You'll finish something you've been putting off. Momentum incoming.
A stranger will hold the door and it will feel oddly wholesome.
You'll make a good decision without even overthinking it.
Your toast will land butter-side up. Both slices. Magic is real.
Green lights the whole way. The city is on your side today.
You'll find the exact thing you were looking for on the first try.
Someone will save you a seat without being asked.
Your favorite snack will be on discount. Destiny approves.
You'll remember a password on the first attempt. All of them, actually.
The group photo will catch you with your eyes open. Photogenic omen.
Leftovers will taste even better tonight than yesterday. Kitchen alchemy.
Your package will arrive early. The courier is your ally now.
You'll say the perfect thing at the perfect moment. Effortlessly.
Buy the lottery ticket. Not because you'll win, because you deserve the thrill.
Today you are unbothered, unstoppable, and slightly untouchable.
The universe owes you one, and today it's paying up.
You will make a decision today that future-you will thank you for.
Rare main-character energy detected. Act accordingly.
Someone is going to compliment you and mean it.
Today, even your typos look intentional.
You're the reason the vibe in the room shifted for the better.
This is a top-percentile Tuesday, regardless of what day it is.
Today, vending machines drop two snacks. This is your era.
You will parallel park on the first try. Witnesses will applaud.
Every queue you join becomes the fast one. Choose wisely. Or don't.
Your internet speed doubles after midnight. The stars filed paperwork for this.
You'll find money you forgot about. Twice.
Strangers will hold doors in a synchronized display of respect.
Your jokes will land. Even the weird one. Especially the weird one.
Today you're operating at main-character frame rate. Everything's smoother.
The group project will go well. You read that correctly.
The stars did not simply align. They rearranged themselves for you.
This has never happened before and statistically may never happen again.
Somewhere, a fortune teller just felt a disturbance and doesn't know why.
You didn't roll this. This rolled you.
Frame this. Tattoo this. Tell your grandchildren about this.
This is not luck. This is the universe formally apologizing for yesterday.
Reality double-checked itself. Numbers like yours shouldn't happen.
Oracle hotlines are lighting up. They're all asking about you.
The universe ran the odds again just to watch it happen once more.
Time itself paused briefly today. It wanted to see what you'd do next.
This isn't a score anymore. It's a historical event with witnesses.
Somewhere, a probability textbook just gained a new footnote. It's you.
